issue.entity: Liberty Northern Services S.A. de C.V.
issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Liberty Northern Services S.A. de C.V. (Mexico) represents USD 1,969,729 in annual spend with dependency on 38 sub-tier suppliers, creating single-source sub-tier concentration risk in North America. Despite a resiliency score of 68 and zero disruption events in the trailing 12 months, the lack of qualified alternate sub-tier sources exposes USD 1.97M in spend to potential supply chain interruption.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping exercise with Liberty Northern Services to identify the 3-5 most critical sub-tier suppliers by spend and strategic importance from the 38 total sub-tier base
Request Liberty Northern Services provide business continuity plans and dual-source commitments for identified critical sub-tier suppliers, with quarterly attestation requirements

Qualify minimum one alternate sub-tier supplier in North America region for each critical sub-tier category identified, requiring Liberty Northern Services cooperation in technical qualification process
Negotiate contractual language requiring Liberty Northern Services to maintain dual sub-tier sources for critical components and provide 90-day advance notice of sub-tier changes
Implement quarterly sub-tier risk monitoring with Liberty Northern Services including financial health checks and capacity reviews of critical sub-tier suppliers

plan.expected_impact: Mitigation of single-source sub-tier risk protecting USD 1,969,729 in annual spend through establishment of alternate sub-tier qualification and contractual dual-source requirements
kpis: Number of critical sub-tier suppliers mapped and documented (target: 100% within 30 days)
Percentage of critical sub-tier categories with qualified alternates (target: 100% within 90 days)
Sub-tier supplier resiliency score improvement (baseline: 68, target: 80+)
Business continuity plan documentation completion rate (target: 100% within 45 days)
Quarterly sub-tier risk review completion rate (target: 100%)
risks: Liberty Northern Services may resist sub-tier transparency due to competitive concerns or supplier relationship constraints
Alternate sub-tier qualification may require tooling investment or technical transfers extending timeline beyond 90 days
Sub-tier suppliers may lack capacity or willingness to serve as alternates given existing Liberty Northern Services commitments
Cost increases of 5-15% possible if alternate sub-tier suppliers require volume commitments or premium pricing
Mexico geo-political or trade policy changes could impact North America regional sourcing strategy for sub-tier base
erp_actions: Add sub-tier supplier tracking custom fields in SAP vendor master (LFA1) for Liberty Northern Services (supplier ID) to capture critical sub-tier dependencies
Create vendor evaluation scheduling in Oracle EBS for quarterly sub-tier risk reviews with mandatory compliance workflow
Configure Coupa supplier risk module to flag Liberty Northern Services for enhanced sub-tier monitoring with automated quarterly questionnaire distribution
Establish contract compliance milestone tracking in Dynamics 365 for dual-source sub-tier requirements with alert triggers at 60 and 90 days
Update NetSuite vendor record with sub-tier dependency flag and link to business continuity plan documentation repository
